column2: Timeline & master checklist — what to do when (semester before, IAP, spring, trip, after), all deadlines
Fundraising — crowdfunding, Giving Tuesday, MIT departments, alumni, events (raffles, boba, bake sales), donor tracking, totals per year
Grants — J-WEL, LEAP, departments, foundations: deadlines, applications, amounts won
Corporate sponsorship & in-kind donations — companies contacted, who said yes/no, outreach templates, sponsor deliverables
Budget & finances — budgets per year, spend by category, travel/pro cards, receipts, reimbursements, tax exemption
MIT & Edgerton Center admin — approvals, cards, insurance, waivers, background checks, photo releases, policies
Route planning — how routes are chosen, tools, each year's route & mileage, rest days, hazards
Housing & hosts — churches, Warmshowers, alumni, schools, campgrounds, motels: how to find them, scripts, who hosted us
Learning festivals & curriculum — finding hosts, scheduling, activities, supplies, surveys, what kids liked
Gear & bikes — bike choice/purchase, fitting, gear lists, packing lists, maintenance, what failed
Support car & logistics — rental (Avis/MIT policy), driver rotation, flights, shipping bikes, start/end travel
Food — budget, groceries, cooking, meal plans, nutrition, food donations/sponsors, dietary needs
Training, safety & health — training plans, first aid, dogs, traffic, heat, injuries, emergency protocol
Media, social media, website & blog — posting strategy, blog schedule, press, graphics, jerseys/merch
Recruiting & onboarding — applications, interviews, team selection, onboarding new members, transition to next team
Top lessons learned & advice from every past team (cross-cutting; strongest, most repeated advice first)
